title: GUI broken [1.78.2 NB 3405]
author: ponchofiesta
body_snippet: I use v1.77.1 as stable version and wanted to try the current build [1.78.2 NB 3405](https://github.com/mRemoteNG/mRemoteNG/releases/tag/20260222-v1.78.2-NB-(3405)) But right after start the GUI looks not OK and I cannot click anywhere. Nothing happens. Environment - Windows 11 25H2 - Multi Monitor with 175% scaling

comments.author: fredriks-eltele
comments.snippet:
Workaround: Right click mRemoteNG.exe, select Properties. Go to Compatibility -> Change high DPI settings. Activate overriding high DPI scaling, set it to Application/Program.

Labels might be different, I'm translating by feel from Norwegian.
